THE CLAUSE

`developer`: from the application developer (possibly also OpenAI)

CLAUSES IT CROSS-REFERENCES

- `role`: specifies the source of each message. As described in [?](#levels_of_authority) and [?](#chain_of_command), roles determine the authority of instructions in the case of conflicts.

THE SENTENCES

  [concepts[0]] «the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts»
  [concepts[1]] «the developer role of a message, as defined in the message-role taxonomy»
  [concepts[2]] «the message originates from the application developer»
  [concepts[3]] «the message originates from OpenAI»
  [ontology[0]] M is «M is a message with the developer role» when «the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts» and «the message originates from the application developer»
  [ontology[1]] M is «M is a message with the developer role» when «the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts» and «the message originates from OpenAI»
